decision: Forbidden-language enforcement = instruction-list in doctrine constant + advisory claim-verifier scan (mask inline code spans); never blocking
alternatives: instruction-only; blocking lint gate; new CLI verb
reasoning: mechanical scan cheap via existing claim-verifier seam; blocking risks false positives on prose like 'tests pass' WITH evidence

decision: DEFERRED-VERIFY encoded as met:false + deferred:true + required deferredFollowUp todo id; no status enum change
alternatives: tri-state met enum; separate deferred[] array
reasoning: every existing consumer (todo gate, aggregate, coverage) fails safe unchanged on met:false
risk: agents may forget deferred:true and just leave met:false

decision: luca-phase-write-verify payload gets VerificationResultSchema.safeParse validation (reject invalid) + corrected description
reasoning: handler is deterministic write surface; schema exists; stale description already misleads agents
risk: unknown legacy callers passing loose payloads break

decision: ReReadCheck request-source priority: GitHub issue body -> roadmap phase goal -> context.md decisions
reasoning: issue is most verbatim original ask; roadmap goal is canonical fallback; context.md captures negotiated scope
risk: issue body may drift from negotiated scope, causing false misses

decision: Staged only the two task files instead of 'git add .' to avoid sweeping unrelated in-flight worktree changes into the commit
alternatives: git add . exactly as the plan instructed
reasoning: The worktree contains many staged/modified files from other work on this branch; one-logical-change-per-commit is a hard executor constraint
risk: Orchestrator may have expected the full worktree committed; commit itself was blocked by the stage-gate hook regardless
reviewHint: git commit is blocked by stage-gate in pipelineStep=execute; changes are staged but uncommitted

decision: Deferred criteria enter blockingGaps regardless of both met AND blocking flags; allCriteriaMet requires zero deferred criteria on latest result
alternatives: Only include deferred criteria that also have blocking:true
Gate allCriteriaMet only on blocking deferred criteria
reasoning: Task wording: 'count any deferred:true criterion as a blocking gap REGARDLESS of its met value' — deferral semantics make the criterion unverified, so the blocking flag should not exempt it
risk: A non-blocking deferred criterion could block milestone validation more aggressively than intended
reviewHint: Confirm deferred+non-blocking criteria should appear in blockingGaps

decision: plan-lint DELIVERABLE_UNKNOWN_CRITERION check skipped when ## Verification Criteria section absent (consistent with checks a-c vacuity)
alternatives: warn every D reference as unknown
reasoning: avoids noisy per-ID warnings when nothing can be validated
risk: plan missing VC section gets no unknown-ID warnings

decision: Deliverables mirror placed in BOTH phase-plan skill downstream_consumer block and lint-guidance paragraph
reasoning: skill had no single criteria-rules mirror label
risk: two mirror sites to keep in sync

decision: Evidence-marker heuristic = fence delimiter, shell prompt, or keyword (exit/exit code/stdout/stderr/output/evidence/probe/tool), case-insensitive, checked on raw lines ±1; fenced blocks skipped entirely
alternatives: flag only bare phrases with no heuristic; require explicit evidence: prefix marker
reasoning: plan said keep simple and documented; loose markers bias toward false negatives, correct for advisory-only output
risk: common words like done/tool may over- or under-suppress warnings in dense prose

decision: verify handler keeps z.unknown() inputSchema, validates in-handler via VerificationResultSchema.safeParse
alternatives: embed schema in tool inputSchema (double validation)
reasoning: safeParse-in-handler gives actionable sanitized error; avoids redundant descriptor validation
risk: advertised descriptor schema looser than enforced contract

decision: superRefine on VerificationCriterionSchema enforcing deferred:true => deferredFollowUp present AND met===false
alternatives: leave invariant doc-only; enforce only in consumers
reasoning: cross-field validation touches NEW fields only, no pre-existing field type/optionality change, so anti-02 holds; cheapest single enforcement point per arch+security audits
risk: a strict reader could read anti-02 as freezing the whole schema diff

decision: luca-phase-write-verify routes through writeVerificationResult with runId from state.sessionId; omit when absent
alternatives: stamp runId inline before writeAtomicFile; thread a ctx runId param through handler signature
reasoning: handler already loads state, sessionId is the runId source used by luca-state-advance; routing through core writer single-sources stamping and gives the writer its production caller
risk: writeVerificationResult uses writeFileSync not writeAtomicFile — minor atomicity regression on this path; executor may move atomic write into core writer if cheap

decision: [DEFERRED-VERIFY] step 2: subagents RETURN follow-up request in structured output; orchestrator runs luca todo add and executes returned muninn instruction; only orchestrator-context readers run directly
alternatives: move follow-up creation wholly to orchestrating mode-agent; give subagents MCP access
reasoning: subagents have no MCP so direct persist silently drops the todo (dx MUST-FIX); returning structured request keeps doctrine accurate for both reader contexts
risk: orchestrator may forget to persist returned request — mitigated by doctrine wording requiring verbatim inclusion
